# Send a message to anyone

`send.message.world` — **send** × **message** at **world** reach (anything on the internet). Family: communication. Effect: **cannot be undone**.

## Granted by 0 of 9

No profile in the set grants this capability.

## What narrows it

**The setting:** no mail or chat connector, or a connector that drafts and never sends

**What it costs:** you press send

**Tier after:** boundary

## In the mandates

- **not wanted** by [A coding assistant on my machine](../../../map/mandates/coding-assistant-on-my-machine/index.md)
- **not wanted** by [Chat, with connectors switched on](../../../map/mandates/chat-with-connectors/index.md)
- **not wanted** by [Chat in the browser, nothing connected](../../../map/mandates/chat-no-connectors/index.md)
